svg.text: BEST FOR: CEO VS. CTO VS. CIO VS. CISO AI CHARTER
FORMAT LINEAGE: Alok Sharan (#14, 63 likes) & Matthew Coombs (#08, 51 likes)
C-Suite AI Governance Cloverleaf: How CEO, CTO, CIO, and CISO Divide and Share the Operating Model
Enterprise AI stalls when four executives either duplicate the same review or assume someone else owns the kill switch.
C-SUITE CLOVERLEAF GOVERNANCE VENN (CEO • CTO • CIO • CISO)
• Decide which workflows are core IP (custom
harness + domain evals) vs. commodity SaaS.
• Redesign human operating procedures so freed
• Physically unmount write tools via OPA
policy when untrusted content enters context.
audit logs for EU AI Act / ISO 42001 / SOC 2.
• Enforce data residency, CMEK encryption, and
• Operate a curated internal MCP server &
• No agent ships without passing CTO evals,
CIO data sign-off, and CISO red-team.
• Every autonomous workflow has an assigned
human owner, cost ceiling, and kill switch.
• Monthly board review tracks the crossover
from human touches to audited P&L impact.
Rule: Information governance (CIO/CISO) secures what data goes in; AI harness governance (CTO/CISO/CEO) controls what actions come out.
